ADID_FREEZE.rationale: Generated receiver ownership belongs to the ADID pipeline.

ADID_OPS.rationale: Tool manuals and framework receivers are capability-specific packs.

CACHE_STABILITY.rationale: Prefix stability is one shared rule; G7 does not restate it.

CLEAN_STATE.rationale: Clean-state output is owned by G9.

CLOSURE_PROOF.rationale: State schema and proof rule have distinct names.

CODE_STANDARDS.rationale: Language and repository style rules are host/project-specific packs.

CONSTITUTION_BLOCKS.rationale: Hard tool blocks must be enforced by runtime policy, not repeated as prompt prose.

DOCUMENT_SURFACE.rationale: Documentation consumers are part of the concrete dependency surface.

EMIT_STATE.rationale: State emission is part of the G9 clean-state contract.

FRAMEWORK_INHERITANCE.rationale: Framework inheritance rules are not universal kernel semantics.

GOAL_PEAKS.rationale: Peak selection is represented by medoid selection under the declared metric.

GOAL_SEEDS.rationale: Seed generation is an internal step of fractal candidate generation.

GROUND.rationale: Grounding is split into intent projection and project evidence geometry.

INFOMARK_SEP.rationale: Status separation is part of the canonical information-status rule.

MEMORY_LINKS.rationale: Exact-handle recovery is part of memory evidence ranking.

METRIC_ADAPTATION.rationale: Metric adaptation is local to attention and evolution measurements.

NAMING.rationale: Plan naming belongs to the master-plan state contract.

NO_HARDCODE.rationale: Configuration discovery depends on the active project and runtime.

NO_SCRIPT_EDITING.rationale: Editing mechanism restrictions depend on available product tools.

OBSOLETE_CLEANUP.rationale: Removal stays inside authorized scope and is verified at closure.

PLANS_COMPLETED.rationale: Plan lifecycle is reconciled only when closure evidence passes.

PLAN_BINDING.rationale: State schema and enforcement rule have distinct, unambiguous names.

PLAN_CONTRACT.rationale: State schema and enforcement rule have distinct, unambiguous names.

PLAN_LIFECYCLE.rationale: Lifecycle is a master-plan field rather than a free-standing global rule.

PLAN_REVISION.rationale: Revision is a master-plan field and reauthorization trigger.

PROGRESS_LOG.rationale: Progress is emitted as concise verified state, not a second protocol.

READ_ENTIRE_FILE.rationale: File-read mechanics and limits belong to product tools.

RESIDUAL_LOOP.rationale: Residual semantics are split into global routing and G9 materialization.

SEARCH_ORDER.rationale: Intent routing and bounded plan grounding replace a universal linear search order.

SMOKE_SPEC.rationale: The baseline rule now includes naming the post-change oracle.

SMOKE_VALIDATE.rationale: Smoke validation is the G8 verification rule.

SV_DELTA.rationale: Attention delta is defined once inside the semantic trajectory rule.

SV_OUTPUT.rationale: The end-of-turn write is the current semantic vector, not the format.

TONE_AND_STYLE.rationale: Tone is a lower-precedence identity or host concern, not execution control.

VCS_ROOT.rationale: VCS traversal restrictions belong to the host's tool constitution.

VERIFY_OUTCOME.rationale: Outcome verification is the oracle's gate-local responsibility.

WHERE_WHICH.rationale: Executable lookup syntax is host-specific, not universal reasoning.

WORKSPACE_LANES.rationale: Workspace topology and lane ownership are project-specific.
